code.client_already_connected: This client is already connected. Disconnect it where it is, or create another client.
code.credential_provisioned: This credential is managed by CTech and cannot be removed here.
code.account_unavailable: CTech Account could not confirm the client right now. Try again in a moment.
code.webhook_endpoint_limit: This mode already has the maximum of 5 endpoints. Delete one to add another.

code.application_busy: Someone else is deciding this application right now. Refresh the page.

code.companies_unavailable: We could not load the organization's companies right now. Try again.
code.webhook_test_too_soon: This endpoint was just tested. Wait half a minute to test it again.
code.byok_certificate_expired: This certificate has expired. Renew it in Inter's Internet Banking and send the new one.
code.byok_certificate_invalid: We could not read the certificate or the key. Send the files downloaded from Inter.
code.byok_key_mismatch: The key does not match the certificate. Send the pair downloaded from the same integration.
code.byok_credentials_refused: Inter refused these credentials. Check the client_id, the client_secret and the account.
code.byok_bearer_refused: Inter accepted the certificate but refused the account or the permissions. Check the account number (with its digit, if Inter shows one) and the Balance and Statement activity on the integration.
code.byok_pix_key_unknown: Inter does not know this Pix key on this account. Check it under Pix > My keys.
code.byok_provider_unavailable: Inter did not answer. Try again in a moment.
code.byok_sandbox_busy: Inter's test environment is busy. Try again in a moment.
code.byok_sync_too_soon: Synced moments ago. Try again in a few minutes.
code.byok_not_connected: This organization has not connected this bank yet.
code.byok_already_connected: This organization is already connected to this bank.
code.byok_sandbox_test_only: The bank's test environment is for test mode only.
code.byok_invalid_request: The connection details are not valid. Check them and try again.
code.byok_connection_changed: The connection changed while you were editing. Try again.
code.account_is_synced: This account is synced with the bank. Its entries come from the statement.
code.customer_tax_id_required: The customer has no CPF or CNPJ. Add one to create the Pix.
code.byok_collection_scopes_missing: The bank integration lacks the collection scopes. Under Pix, tick the due-charge, received-Pix, refund and webhook permissions.
code.byok_quota_exceeded: The plan's charges are used up this month. Change plans to keep collecting.
code.byok_charge_open: This invoice's Pix can still be paid.
code.byok_charge_ended: This invoice's Pix expired unpaid. Create a new Pix.
code.byok_charge_pending: The Pix was not created at the bank yet. Try creating it again.
code.byok_not_collecting: This organization does not collect through a bank connection.
code.byok_open_charges: There are open charges. Disconnecting cancels all of them.
code.byok_webhook_conflict: Another system receives the payment webhooks of this Pix key.
code.byok_webhook_unavailable: The payment webhook is not available right now. Confirmations arrive within an hour.
code.refund_window_closed: More than 90 days passed since the payment. Inter no longer accepts the refund.
code.tenant_zero_rail: CTech's own collection rail is changed by the CTech team.
code.invalid_collection_settings: Use a fine up to 20% and interest up to 10% a month.
code.byok_sandbox_webhook_shared: The sandbox payment webhooks are managed by CTech.
code.subscription_limit_reached: Active subscriptions are at the plan's limit. Change plans to create more.
code.bank_connection_limit_reached: Bank connections are at the plan's limit. Change plans to connect another bank.
code.plan_not_found: This organization has no plan yet.
code.plan_live_only: The plan is changed in live mode.
